concerns.text: The plan lists `bitsandbytes==0.43.1` for 4‑bit quantization of TinyLlama‑1.1B. Bitsandbytes’ 4‑bit quantization currently requires CUDA/GPU support; it cannot run on the CPU‑only GitHub Actions runner stipulated by the project (FR‑007, FR‑009). This makes the quantization step infeasible under the stated resource constraints and would likely cause the pipeline to fail or exceed the 7 GB RAM limit.
